acceptance: Sealed artifacts and caches can be re-encrypted under the newest data key without renaming them, and a tenant's key material can be exported wrapped and imported elsewhere so bundles of private versions open there.

positive.fixture: rewrap moves private artifacts to the newest key without renaming; a tenant export opens its bundles in another installation and nothing else

negative.fixture: a rewrap killed at three points leaves everything readable and the next run finishes; early retirement; identical content invisible across tenants

security_and_source_permissions: Exports are PBKDF2-wrapped; imports below the written iteration count are refused.
performance_memory_storage: Rewrap reads and rewrites each private object once.
known_limitations: Guarded retirement and merging adoption were added in VSF-B14-T15
Multi-process keyring sharing is not supported
